class Webhook::Delivery < ApplicationRecord
  STALE_THRESHOLD = 7.days
  ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT = 7.seconds
  USER_AGENT = "fizzy/1.0.0 Webhook"

  belongs_to :account, default: -> { webhook.account }
  belongs_to :webhook
  belongs_to :event

  store :request, coder: JSON
  store :response, coder: JSON

  enum :state, %w[ pending in_progress completed errored ].index_by(&:itself), default: :pending

  scope :ordered, -> { order created_at: :desc, id: :desc }
  scope :stale, -> { where(created_at: ..STALE_THRESHOLD.ago) }

  def self.cleanup
    stale.delete_all
  end

  def deliver_later
    Current.with_account(account) do
      Webhook::DeliveryJob.perform_later(self)
    end
  end

  def deliver
    return unless pending? && webhook.present? && event.present?

    if claim_for_delivery(headers)
      deliver_to_endpoint
      track_delinquency
    end
  end
  alias_method :deliver_now, :deliver

  def sanitized_request
    if headers = request&.dig("headers")&.except("X-Webhook-Signature")
      { headers: headers }
    end
  end

  def response_summary
    if response.present?
      { code: response[:code], error: response[:error] }
    end
  end

  def failed?
    (errored? || completed?) && !succeeded?
  end

  def succeeded?
    completed? && response[:error].blank? && response[:code].between?(200, 299)
  end

  private
    def headers
      {
        "User-Agent" => USER_AGENT,
        "Content-Type" => content_type,
        "X-Webhook-Signature" => signature,
        "X-Webhook-Timestamp" => event.created_at.utc.iso8601(3)
      }
    end

    def content_type
      if webhook.for_campfire?
        "text/html"
      else
        "application/json"
      end
    end

    def signature
      OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", webhook.signing_secret, payload)
    end

    def payload
      @payload ||= if webhook.for_slack?
        { text: slack_text }.to_json
      elsif webhook.for_basecamp?
        { content: render_payload(formats: :html) }.to_json
      elsif webhook.for_campfire?
        render_payload(formats: :html)
      else
        render_payload(formats: :json)
      end
    end

    def slack_text
      render_payload(formats: :html)
        .gsub(/<a href="([^"]+)">([^<]+)<\/a>/i, '<\1|\2>')
        .gsub(""", '"')
        .gsub("'", "'")
        .squish
    end

    def render_payload(formats:)
      Current.with(account: account, user: nil) do
        renderer.render(template: "webhooks/event", formats: [ formats ], layout: false, assigns: { event: event })
      end
    end

    def renderer
      ApplicationController.renderer.new(renderer_options)
    end

    def renderer_options
      base_options = Rails.application.routes.default_url_options.presence ||
        Rails.application.config.action_mailer.default_url_options ||
        {}

      options = { script_name: account.slug }
      if host = base_options[:host]
        options[:http_host] = base_options[:port] && !host.include?(":") ? "#{host}:#{base_options[:port]}" : host
      end
      options[:https] = (base_options[:protocol].to_s == "https") unless base_options[:protocol].nil?
      options
    end

    def claim_for_delivery(request_headers)
      with_lock do
        if pending?
          self.request = { headers: request_headers }
          in_progress!
          true
        else
          false
        end
      end
    end

    def deliver_to_endpoint
      destination_ip = resolve_destination_ip

      if destination_ip.nil?
        errored_with(:destination_unreachable)
      else
        http_response = perform_http_request(destination_ip)
        completed_with(http_response)
      end
    rescue OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError
      errored_with(:ssl_error)
    rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, Net::WriteTimeout, Timeout::Error
      errored_with(:connection_timeout)
    rescue Resolv::ResolvError, Resolv::ResolvTimeout, SocketError, SystemCallError, IOError, EOFError, Net::ProtocolError, URI::InvalidURIError
      errored_with(:destination_unreachable)
    end

    def resolve_destination_ip
      ip = SsrfProtection.resolve_public_ip(uri.hostname)

      if ip.present?
        ip
      elsif Rails.env.test? && unstubbed_offline_dns? && !blocked_literal_host?(uri.hostname)
        :unresolved_in_offline_test
      end
    end

    def uri
      @uri ||= URI.parse(webhook.url)
    end

    def unstubbed_offline_dns?
      Resolv::DNS.method(:open).source_location&.first&.end_with?("/resolv.rb") &&
        SsrfProtection.method(:resolve_public_ip).source_location&.first&.end_with?("/ssrf_protection.rb") &&
        dns_network_unreachable?
    end

    def dns_network_unreachable?
      socket = UDPSocket.new
      socket.connect(SsrfProtection::DNS_NAMESERVERS.first, 53)
      false
    rescue Errno::ENETUNREACH, Errno::EHOSTUNREACH, Errno::EADDRNOTAVAIL
      true
    ensure
      socket&.close
    end

    def blocked_literal_host?(hostname)
      if hostname.blank? || hostname.casecmp?("localhost") || hostname.downcase.end_with?(".localhost")
        true
      else
        IPAddr.new(hostname)
        SsrfProtection.blocked_address?(hostname)
      end
    rescue IPAddr::InvalidAddressError
      false
    end

    def perform_http_request(destination_ip)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.hostname, uri.port, nil)
      http.ipaddr = destination_ip if destination_ip.is_a?(String)
      http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == "https")
      http.open_timeout = ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT
      http.read_timeout = ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT
      http.write_timeout = ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT
      http.max_retries = 0

      post_request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri, headers)
      post_request.body = payload

      http.request(post_request)
    end

    def completed_with(http_response)
      update!(
        state: :completed,
        response: { code: http_response.code.to_i, headers: http_response.to_hash }
      )
    end

    def errored_with(error)
      update!(
        state: :errored,
        response: { error: error }
      )
    end

    def track_delinquency
      tracker = webhook.delinquency_tracker || webhook.create_delinquency_tracker!
      tracker.record_delivery_of(self)
    end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

class Webhook::DelinquencyTrackerTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  PUBLIC_IP = "93.184.216.34"

  setup do
    stub_dns_resolution(PUBLIC_IP)
    @webhook = Webhook.create!(
      board: boards(:writebook),
      name: "Delinquency Test",
      url: "https://receiver.example.com/webhooks",
      subscribed_actions: [ "card_published" ]
    )
    @event = events(:logo_published)
  end

  test "switches off webhook after 10 consecutive failures spanning an hour" do
    stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 500)

    freeze_time do
      deliver_once
      assert @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 1, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count
      assert_equal Time.current, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.first_failure_at

      travel 30.minutes
      8.times { deliver_once }
      assert @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 9, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count

      travel 31.minutes
      deliver_once

      assert_not @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 10, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count
    end
  end

  test "does not switch off after 10 consecutive failures within less than an hour" do
    stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 502)

    freeze_time do
      deliver_once

      travel 59.minutes
      9.times { deliver_once }

      assert @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 10, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count

      # Next failure past the 1-hour mark switches it off
      travel 2.minutes
      deliver_once

      assert_not @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 11, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count
    end
  end

  test "does not switch off after fewer than 10 consecutive failures even over an hour" do
    stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_timeout

    freeze_time do
      deliver_once

      travel 2.hours
      8.times { deliver_once }

      assert @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 9, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count
    end
  end

  test "successful delivery resets failure streak" do
    freeze_time do
      stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 500)
      deliver_once

      travel 45.minutes
      8.times { deliver_once }
      assert_equal 9, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.reload.consecutive_failures_count

      WebMock.reset!
      stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 200)
      deliver_once

      @webhook.delinquency_tracker.reload
      assert_equal 0, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.consecutive_failures_count
      assert_nil @webhook.delinquency_tracker.first_failure_at
      assert @webhook.reload.active?

      # Subsequent single failure past the original 1-hour mark does not switch off
      WebMock.reset!
      stub_request(:post, @webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 500)
      travel 30.minutes
      deliver_once

      assert @webhook.reload.active?
      assert_equal 1, @webhook.delinquency_tracker.reload.consecutive_failures_count
    end
  end

  private
    def deliver_once
      delivery = @webhook.trigger(@event)
      delivery.deliver
    end
end

require "test_helper"

class WebhooksIntegrationTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  PUBLIC_IP = "93.184.216.34"

  setup do
    stub_dns_resolution(PUBLIC_IP)
    sign_in_as :kevin
  end

  test "board event posts to webhook, logs outcome in UI and JSON API, and switches off when delinquent" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.webhooks.destroy_all

    post board_webhooks_path(board), params: {
      webhook: {
        name: "Board Hook",
        url: "https://receiver.example.com/events",
        subscribed_actions: [ "card_published", "card_closed" ]
      }
    }
    webhook = Webhook.last
    assert_redirected_to board_webhook_path(board, webhook)

    ok_request = stub_request(:post, webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 200)

    # Drafting a card does not trigger the webhook until published
    perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
      post board_cards_path(board)
    end
    assert_not_requested ok_request

    draft_card = board.cards.order(:created_at).last
    perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
      post card_publish_path(draft_card)
    end

    assert_requested ok_request, times: 1

    # HTML show page displays the delivery log
    get board_webhook_path(board, webhook)
    assert_response :success
    delivery = webhook.deliveries.last
    assert_select "li##{dom_id(delivery)}.delivery--succeeded strong", text: "completed"

    # JSON deliveries log returns sanitized headers, response summary, and event
    get board_webhook_deliveries_path(board, webhook), as: :json
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal 1, @response.parsed_body.size
    entry = @response.parsed_body.first
    assert_equal delivery.id, entry["id"]
    assert_equal "completed", entry["state"]
    assert_equal 200, entry.dig("response", "code")
    assert_nil entry.dig("response", "error")
    assert_equal "card_published", entry.dig("event", "action")
    assert_not entry.dig("request", "headers").key?("X-Webhook-Signature")

    # 10 consecutive failures over an hour switch the webhook off
    WebMock.reset!
    failing_request = stub_request(:post, webhook.url).with(ipaddr: PUBLIC_IP).to_return(status: 503)

    freeze_time do
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
        post card_closure_path(draft_card)
      end
      assert webhook.reload.active?

      travel 15.minutes
      8.times do |i|
        perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
          post board_cards_path(board), params: { card: { title: "Card #{i}" } }, as: :json
        end
      end
      assert webhook.reload.active?

      travel 46.minutes
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
        post board_cards_path(board), params: { card: { title: "Final failing card" } }, as: :json
      end
    end

    assert_not webhook.reload.active?
    assert_requested failing_request, times: 10

    # Show page offers Reactivate button when switched off
    get board_webhook_path(board, webhook)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "button", text: "Reactivate"

    # While switched off, new events do not POST to the receiver
    perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ Event::RelayJob, Webhook::DeliveryJob ] do
      post board_cards_path(board), params: { card: { title: "Ignored while inactive" } }, as: :json
    end
    assert_requested failing_request, times: 10

    # Reactivating re-enables deliveries with a reset failure tracker
    post board_webhook_activation_path(board, webhook)
    assert webhook.reload.active?
    assert_equal 0, webhook.delinquency_tracker.reload.consecutive_failures_count
  end
end
EOF

messages.content:
Board webhooks have been implemented on top of the existing webhook settings:

- **Event Relaying & Triggering (`Event::Relaying`, `Event::RelayJob`, `Webhook::Triggerable`)**: When a board event is committed, `Event::RelayJob` triggers all active webhooks on that board subscribed to the event's action, creating a pending `Webhook::Delivery` and enqueueing `Webhook::DeliveryJob` on the `webhooks` queue.
- **Single-Attempt HTTP POST Delivery & Logging (`Webhook::Delivery`, `Webhook::DeliveryJob`)**: Atomically claims `pending` deliveries (`in_progress`), renders the event payload (JSON for standard webhooks, formatted payloads for Slack, Basecamp, and Campfire), signs the body with `X-Webhook-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256) alongside `User-Agent`, `Content-Type`, and `X-Webhook-Timestamp`, enforces SSRF protection with IP pinning, disables HTTP retries/redirects so each event is delivered at most once, and records request headers and response status/errors (`completed` / `errored`) for the UI and JSON delivery logs.
- **Delinquency Deactivation (`Webhook::DelinquencyTracker`)**: Tracks consecutive delivery failures and `first_failure_at` per webhook, automatically deactivating a webhook after 10 consecutive failures spanning at least 1 hour, resetting on any successful delivery or manual reactivation.
- **One-Week Log Retention (`Webhook::Delivery.cleanup`)**: Prunes delivery log entries older than 7 days (`1.week.ago`) as invoked by the recurring cleanup task.
